title: Run pre-commit hooks via uv with --only-group lint
answers: how do I run pre-commit hooks in this repo
uv run pre-commit fails or syncs too much, how to run lint hooks
how to install pre-commit hooks for MLflow development
run ruff and typos checks on a single file before committing
body:
Run pre-commit through the lint dependency group, not the full dev environment:
  uv run --only-group lint pre-commit run --files path/to/file.py
  uv run --only-group lint pre-commit run --all-files
  uv run --only-group lint pre-commit run ruff --all-files
Install hooks with: uv run --only-group lint pre-commit install --install-hooks
The --only-group lint flag stops uv from syncing the whole dev environment just to run the hooks.
The hooks (Ruff, typos checker, and others) run automatically on commit once installed.
applies: Local developer and agent workflows for running or installing this repo's pre-commit hooks.
says: Git commit hooks take too long because the tool syncs the entire development environment.
Run code formatting and spell checks on a single modified file before committing changes.
Install automated git commit checks for style rules and typos without downloading full dependencies.
Check all project files for lint and spelling errors using only necessary linting tools.
Commit validation fails or hangs trying to install unrelated development packages for pre-commit checks.
search: Running and installing pre-commit hooks via uv run --only-group lint to avoid syncing the full development environment. Developers and agents run pre-commit against specific files, all files, or individual hooks like ruff, and install hooks with uv run --only-group lint pre-commit install --install-hooks. Documented in CLAUDE.md, ensuring Ruff, typos checker, and other hooks run automatically on commit.
